messages:
nina: Following up on the 2026-03-10 postmortem (missing spans + aggregation drift). We need concrete owners, short timelines, and a plan to prevent recurrence. Postmortem here: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-10-spans-agg

tom: agree. quick root-cause summary: ETL batch timing + timezone misalign caused partial ingestion windows + a downstream join that assumed contiguous keys. that led to ~6% loss for several services.

lucas: i'll take the join/aggregation code change to make joins null-safe and resilient to missing windows. i'll add unit tests and a canary rollout. ETA 6 business days.

marta: i'll own span-sampling instrumentation + coverage metrics. plan: add a span_coverage metric per service, emit to observability, and wire an alert. ETA 3 days.

rachel: i'll coordinate the backfill orchestration. proposed constraints: 48h max window per backfill job, `--dry-run` first, and a progressive throttle. ETA dry-run 2d, phased backfill 7d.

nina: good. required remediation items from the postmortem: 1) harden aggregator joins, 2) add span coverage metric & alert, 3) implement controlled backfill, 4) CI regression tests to catch rollup deltas, 5) quarterly audit of aggregator assumptions.

tom: for CI tests i can add a synthetic dataset and a nightly regression that verifies rollup_total ≈ raw_spans within 8%. will block merges that touch rollup logic. ETA 4d.

marta: alert proposal: coverage-sweep every 6h, cron `0 */6 * * *`, alert if coverage_ratio < 0.85 for any service for 2 consecutive runs. also emit a short daily digest to #observability.

rachel: backfill job named `spans.backfill.controlled.v1`. will include `--dry-run`, `--max-window=48h`, `--throttle=500/s`. will produce a report CSV of affected services/time ranges.

lucas: i'll include a migration that fills safe defaults for new key columns where appropriate to avoid null-join gaps. i'll coordinate with infra for a low-impact window.

alert-bot: historical-pattern-detect: matching incidents detected on 2025-10-12 and 2026-01-05. recurring-pattern flagged. recommend quarterly "aggregator-assumptions" audit.

nina: owners + ETAs summary: lucas=aggregator hardening & migration (6d), marta=coverage metric & alert (3d), rachel=controlled backfill (2d dry-run / 7d phased), tom=CI regression (4d), nina=update postmortem/runbook & remediation tracking (1d). please confirm here.

marta: confirmed. i'll push the metric and alert playbook today.

lucas: confirmed. i'll open PR with before/after delta charts and safe rollback gate.

tom: confirmed. i'll add the synthetic dataset and CI job; will make it run on PRs and nightly.

rachel: confirmed. i'll submit the backfill job with dry-run output to this thread for review.

nina: i'll add a quarterly calendar invite "aggregator-assumptions-audit" and own the checklist. weekly remediation check-ins until all items closed. marking P1 in the remediation tracker now. ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
